title: Cache lookup and insert split across two locks
description: A project-owned semantic review case where a single locked critical section is split so the check and the act no longer hold the lock together.
diff:
diff --git a/pkg/counter/registry.go b/pkg/counter/registry.go
--- a/pkg/counter/registry.go
+++ b/pkg/counter/registry.go
@@ -16,12 +16,15 @@ func NewRegistry() *Registry {
 
 func (r *Registry) IDFor(name string) int {
 	r.mu.Lock()
-	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+	existing, ok := r.ids[name]
+	r.mu.Unlock()
 
-	if existing, ok := r.ids[name]; ok {
+	if ok {
 		return existing
 	}
 
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
 	id := r.next
 	r.next++
 	r.ids[name] = id

expectedFindings.semanticSummary: the lock is released between reading ids[name] and inserting a new id, so two goroutines can both miss and assign different ids for the same name while incrementing next twice; hold one lock across the check and insert
